text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—I've gained weight recently! Even though the race is so close!”
“—Me too! I really hate dieting.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! I've heard all about it.
Allow me to show you what's possible.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you hate hard work,
then just think of a happy way to lose weight!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, let me hear the song of your soul!
Come on, come on, get into the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This place is famous for bottle rockets! Let's go find a great viewing spot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a waterslide sounds nice!
...Though the stairs to the top are intense...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That spa trip totally detoxed me!
Now for the grand finale—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance party!!
Let's enjoy the moment to the fullest!!
Whoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, great!
Show me even more of your potential!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeking the Pearl kept this up the entire time,
and before she knew it, she had regained her original figure."
